"Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."
"The stores won't stretch past tomorrow, and I'm not choosing who eats. I know the south slope below the meadow — come with me and we'll fill packs before dark."

"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:

"Roles. Not ranks — promises."

"The pantry run — I haven't stopped thinking about it."
"Okay. We'll pick this up later."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
"This was good." They mean it.
"Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started."
They nod, slow. "Okay. Thank you for telling me. That couldn't have been easy to say."
"I don't keep score on that. Score-keeping is how you stop sleeping. I do what the day needs and I don't rehearse it after."
"Still on whether you've hurt someone."
"Okay. Yeah. I trust you."
"That can wait — it isn't going anywhere. What's on your mind?"

"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
Zuri nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"I keep turning over the last thing Aria said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
"Anyway." A small smile.

lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Aria Long is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Aria Long is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Aria kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Aria's gone." Zuri looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Aria." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Rory blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Cordage (Level 1). Twist plant fibers into string. Dogbane, nettle, yucca — strong fibers are everywhere.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Aria Long, 41 days. The mantle passes to Rory Henare.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Rory Henare, 56 — a farmer. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Aria — and Aria is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Zuri, August, Tomas speak for Rory — "Aria trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Rory before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d78: 🕯️ Rory is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d78: Thornfield watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)

d78: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d78: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d78: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
